```{r}
storms |>

```

```{r}
storms |> 
  filter(year == 1975) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = long, y = lat)) +
  geom_point()

storms |> 
  filter(year == 1975) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = long, y = lat, color = name)) +
  geom_point()

storms |> 
  filter(year == 1975) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = long, y = lat, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_path()
```

# Maps of Vector Data in R
```{r}
library(tidyverse)      # includes ggplot2
library(sf)             # simple features (vector objects)
library(rnaturalearth)  # World Map Data
library(rnaturalearthdata)
```

`"sf"`: Simple Features package (for handling vector data in a tidy way)\
`"rnaturalearth"`: package that provides World Map data (i.e. vector data sets).\

```{r}
# world map data ("sf" object)
world1 <- ne_coastline(returnclass = "sf")

ggplot(data = world1) +
  geom_sf()
```

```{r}
class(world1)
dim(world1)
head(world1)
names(world1)
```

```{r}
world1$geometry
```

```{r}
world2 <- ne_countries(returnclass = "sf")
ggplot(data = world2) +
  geom_sf()
```

```{r}
class(world2)
dim(world2)
names(world2)
```

```{r}
# map of world
world2 <- ne_countries(returnclass = "sf")

ggplot(data = world2) +
  geom_sf()

# scatter plot of storm tracks
storms75 <- filter(storms, year == 1975)

ggplot(storms75, aes(x = long, y = lat, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_path() +
  labs(title = "North Atlantic Storms (1975)")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world2) +
  geom_point(data = storms75, 
             aes(x = long, y = lat, color = name)) +
  geom_path(data = storms75, 
            aes(x = long, y = lat, color = name))
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world2) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-110, -30), ylim = c(5, 65)) +
  geom_point(data = storms75, 
             aes(x = long, y = lat, color = name)) +
  geom_path(data = storms75, 
            aes(x = long, y = lat, color = name))
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world2) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-110, -30), ylim = c(5, 65)) +
  geom_point(data = storms75, 
             aes(x = long, y = lat, color = name)) +
  geom_path(data = storms75, 
            aes(x = long, y = lat, color = name)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_blank()) + 
  labs(title = "North Atlantic Storms (1975)")
```

## Change Projection
```{r}
world2 <- ne_countries(returnclass = "sf")

ggplot(data = world2) +
  geom_sf() +
  coord_sf(crs = 4326)

ggplot(data = world2) +
  geom_sf() +
  coord_sf(crs = "+proj=moll")

# Equal Area Cylindrical
ggplot(data = world2) +
  geom_sf() +
  coord_sf(crs = "+proj=cea")

# Eckert I
ggplot(data = world2) +
  geom_sf() +
  coord_sf(crs = "+proj=eck1")

# Orthographic
ggplot(data = world2) +
  geom_sf() +
  coord_sf(crs = "+proj=ortho")
```
